Deal_Title: Choctaw Resort Development Enterprise issues $200 million of 9 1/4% Senior Notes due 2009
Native_Party: Choctaw Resort Development Enterprise (Mississippi Band of Choctaw Indians)
Description: The Enterprise issued $200,000,000 of unsecured 9 1/4% Senior Notes due 2009. Proceeds were to retire a $75 million term loan and to finance construction of the Golden Moon at the Pearl River Resort.

Deal_Title: ASRC Industrial Services acquires Environmental Quality Management, Inc.
Value_Type: Purchase price, of which $350,000 was retained at closing as holdbacks for items specified in the purchase agreement
Description: ASRC Industrial Services, LLC acquired 100% of the outstanding stock of Environmental Quality Management, Inc., which provides environmental remediation, project management, emergency response and environmental consulting services primarily to the federal government, based in Cincinnati, Ohio with satellite offices throughout the United States. A provisional goodwill estimate of $8,520,000 was recognised.
Source_1_Type: ANCSA corporation annual report filed with the Alaska Division of Banking and Securities (STAR portal)

Deal_Title: NTIA TBCP award: Samish Indian Nation
Description: Use & Adoption. This project proposes to address the current digital divide by conducting an analysis of internet assets, digital literacy skills, and the availability of broadband equipment and devices for Samish Tribal citizens.

Deal_Title: NTIA TBCP award: Apache Tribe of Oklahoma
Description: Broadband Infrastructure Deployment. The Broadband Infrastructure Deployment project proposes to install an 80-mile, middle mile fiber path that will directly connect 36 community anchor institutions as a last mile system. Additionally, this middle mile fiber will connect to a3.6 GHz fixed wireless system in the community, which will be used to connect 900 unserved Native American households and 860 Native American businesses with qualifying 100/20 Mbps broadband speeds.

Deal_Title: NTIA TBCP award: California Rural Indian Health Board
Description: This Planning, Engineering, Feasibility, and Sustainability Studies project will complete environmental technical studies and compliance documents, as well as design and engineering to support future deployment of middle mile fiber and last mile fiber to the premise within the Fort Bidwell Indian Community.

Deal_Title: EDA ARPA Indigenous Communities award: Seneca Nation of Indians
Counterparty_or_Funder: U.S. Economic Development Administration (ARPA Indigenous Communities Program)
Description: This EDA investment supports the Seneca Nation of Indians with implementing the Economic Accelerator and Recovery project to establish a Visitor Economy Management Office (VEMO) and develop a waterfront development feasibility study. The project will increase the Seneca Nation’s capacity to sustain tourism initiatives, to attract visitors to the area, and to be resilient in the face of future economic downturns. Once completed, the project will provide new employment opportunities with improved wages, save jobs, and boost the socioeconomic factors on the Reservation.
